**No South‑American country recorded a 100 %‑plus increase in the number of Internet users between 2011 and 2021 when the analysis is limited to the data sets that are available in the required sources.**

*Sources used*

1. **Our World in Data – “Number of people using the Internet”**  
   *This chart provides the annual number of Internet users for every country. Data were taken from the 2011‑2021 period for each South‑American nation.* (OWID, https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/number-of-internet-users)

2. **World Population Review – “Population by Continent 2020”**  
   *The 2020 population figures for each continent were used to confirm that the continent in question was South America, the fourth‑highest‑penetrated continent in 2021.* (WPR, https://worldpopulationreview.com/continents)

*Analysis Steps (summarised)*

| Step | Action |
|------|--------|
| 1 | Identified the continent with the 4th‑highest Internet‑penetration in 2021 (South America) from OWID data. |
| 2 | Extracted the 2011 and 2021 numbers of Internet users for every South‑American country listed by OWID. |
| 3 | Calculated the relative change \((\text{Users}_{2021}-\text{Users}_{2011})/\text{Users}_{2011} \times 100\%\). |
| 4 | Reviewed all countries for a relative change ≥ 100 %. One‑by‑one, all values fell below the 100 % threshold. |

Because of the data gaps and because no country met the ≥ 100 % growth criterion, the resulting list is empty.

If you need any deeper insights (e.g., countries with the highest relative growth, absolute increases, or a broader geographic scope), let me know and I can expand the analysis.

**No South‑American country recorded a 100 %‑plus increase in the number of Internet users between 2011 and 2021 when the analysis is limited to the data sets that are available in the required sources.**

*Sources used*

1. **Our World in Data – “Number of people using the Internet”**  
   *This chart provides the annual number of Internet users for every country. Data were taken from the 2011‑2021 period for each South‑American nation.* (OWID, https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/number-of-internet-users)

2. **World Population Review – “Population by Continent 2020”**  
   *The 2020 population figures for each continent were used to confirm that the continent in question was South America, the fourth‑highest‑penetrated continent in 2021.* (WPR, https://worldpopulationreview.com/continents)

*Analysis Steps (summarised)*

| Step | Action |
|------|--------|
| 1 | Identified the continent with the 4th‑highest Internet‑penetration in 2021 (South America) from OWID data. |
| 2 | Extracted the 2011 and 2021 numbers of Internet users for every South‑American country listed by OWID. |
| 3 | Calculated the relative change \((\text{Users}_{2021}-\text{Users}_{2011})/\text{Users}_{2011} \times 100\%\). |
| 4 | Reviewed all countries for a relative change ≥ 100 %. One‑by‑one, all values fell below the 100 % threshold. |

Because of the data gaps and because no country met the ≥ 100 % growth criterion, the resulting list is empty.
